bull.b: The absence of borrowings and stated cash runway provide financial flexibility while the company invests in prediction markets. This conservative capital structure can help absorb operating volatility and fund obligations without immediate dependence on debt financing.

The public launch creates a new growth platform beyond the shrinking casino base, with a full year of commercial operations expected in 2027. If adoption develops, the offering could materially broaden revenue sources and improve operating scale.

Higher revenue per customer and improved monetization per dollar wagered indicate a healthier remaining casino customer base despite reduced scale. These gains could support better customer economics and more disciplined acquisition as the business reallocates resources.

bear.b: A 51% quarterly revenue decline shows that the existing casino operation is contracting materially before the new platform has proven its contribution. Sustained lower revenue reduces operating leverage and raises the execution burden for prediction markets to replace lost volume.

Worsening losses alongside higher operating cash use indicate that the current business is not self-funding. Continued investment in the new platform may accelerate cash consumption, making future financial stability increasingly dependent on successful monetization and cost control.

Leaving New Zealand removes an existing source of casino revenue and creates an additional headwind just as prediction markets are beginning commercial operations. The full impact in the first quarter of 2027 increases pressure on the new platform to offset the lost business.
